facts: New snow possible today: the forecast snow level drops to 5,800 ft, below the pass, with a 94% chance of precipitation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: The nearby stations disagree about this year: snow left Harts Pass (6,490 ft) 8 days later and Salmon Meadows (4,460 ft) 16 days earlier than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: June 3 (2023), June 16 (2024), June 6 (2025)

evidence.name: Salmon Meadows
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 3 (2023), April 19 (2024), April 19 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and the lowest at Salmon Meadows (4,460 ft).

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: 59.7 in on April 5; earlier seasons: 53.6 in (2023), 36.2 in (2024), 37.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Salmon Meadows
evidence.detail: 0.6 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 13.6 in (2023), 6.4 in (2024), 10.0 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 28 and June 27, carried from the melt-out dates at Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and Salmon Meadows (4,460 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 14, 68 ft below the pass; points to May 24 to July 7

evidence.name: Salmon Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 2,098 ft below the pass; points to April 2 to June 16
